Name: MultiBone
Description: Will create multiple bones with controllers

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Will create multiple bones with controllers.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParents: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- CtrlColor: choose one option (for example: yellow, lightBlue, blue, white).
- CtrlType: choose one option (for example: sphere, square, cube, octagon).
- Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Head_Jnt, L_Wrist_Jnt.

Tips:
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
